summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: f77r.15 contains shedy qotol shedy qokaiin, an exact A-B-A order that may be a cycle of atmospheric phases or a repeated participant in a hydraulic record.

design.scope_description: Only already exposed f77r text/labels and cached Aristotle I.9-12 source; no new image or selector.
design.mechanism: Phase-cycle reading treats the repeated written form as a cycle-position token; rival treats it as a content participant repeated in a flow statement.
design.unit: Exact whole-form sequences at named f77r loci.
design.contrast: Cyclic phase notation versus repeated hydraulic participant
design.prediction: Cycle reading predicts A-B-A order around distinct phase forms and recurrence of the same order signature; hydraulic reading predicts monotonic source/carrier/endpoint sequencing and need not preserve A-B-A.
concrete_observations: GDT930 quotes f77r.15 `shedy qotol shedy qokaiin`; GDT932 records the same written repetition in its complete f77r context.
linked_consequences: A cycle model predicts the same order motif at another weather-like locus; hydraulic reading predicts a directional chain with different neighbor order.
design.nearest_rival: Cyclic phase notation versus repeated hydraulic participant
design.distinguishing_observation: Use exact trigram order and neighbor-class recurrence, not identity assumptions; require a second written A-B-A or a clear monotonic counterpattern.
design.strongest_likely_failure: Only one A-B-A trigram is available and repeated forms need not denote a cycle or participant.
